set.description: 形如 A/B（A、B 为整式且 B 含字母）的式子叫分式，分母不为 0 时分式有意义，分子为 0 且分母不为 0 时值为 0。
set.name: The Concept of Algebraic Fractions

criteria: 能完成分式乘除
结果化为最简
set.description: 分式相乘分子乘分子、分母乘分母；除以分式等于乘它的倒数，乘除后要约分。
set.name: Multiplication and Division of Rational Expressions

criteria: 能完成同分母与异分母加减
符号处理正确
set.description: 同分母分式相加减分母不变，异分母先通分；结果化为最简。
set.name: Addition and Subtraction of Rational Expressions

criteria: 能确定运算顺序
结果为最简分式
set.description: 按先乘方、再乘除、后加减、有括号先算括号的顺序进行混合运算，并化简求值。
set.name: Mixed Operations with Rational Expressions, Simplification, and Evaluation
set.nameZh: 分式的混合运算与化简求值

set.description: 乘积为 1 的两个数互为倒数，0 没有倒数。
set.name: Reciprocals

criteria: 会用交换律结合律重新组合
能简化多个有理数的加法
set.description: 把小学的交换律、结合律推广到有理数，用于凑整、同号结合等简算。
set.name: Properties of Addition and Efficient Calculation
set.nameZh: 加法运算律与简便运算

criteria: 能判断一组对象能不能组成集合
能说出元素和集合的区别
set.description: 知道集合由确定的对象组成，这些对象叫做元素。
set.name: Meaning of a Set

set.reason: The comprehensive mixed-operation scope contains algebraic-fraction multiplication and division steps.
set.scope: multiplication and division parts of mixed operations

set.reason: It also contains addition/subtraction steps, which must handle denominator alignment and numerator combination.
set.scope: addition and subtraction parts of mixed operations

set.reason: The harmonic-operation associativity proof simplifies rational expressions on the positive domain. A specified set and membership are essential. Nested substitution, even-number closure, square-product closure and rational simplification are separate examples or routes, not universal requirements for every binary operation.
set.scope: compare nested rational custom-operation expressions

set.reason: Closure and identity statements quantify over the stated set, not over an assumed larger domain. A specified set and membership are essential. Nested substitution, even-number closure, square-product closure and rational simplification are separate examples or routes, not universal requirements for every binary operation.
set.scope: specified set and admissible elements

criteria: Check that every allowed input has a defined output in the set; one counterexample disproves closure.
Determine two-sided identities/inverses and prove or refute nested-operation laws with universal arguments or counterexamples.
set.description: On a specified set, check operation definedness and closure; prove or refute commutativity, associativity, identities, inverses and stated distributive laws from the operation rules and full domain.
set.name: Closure and identities of defined operations
set.nameZh: 自定义运算的封闭性与运算法则

criteria: Apply the stated rule or row-column table lookup to the actual ordered pair.
Evaluate nested expressions from the innermost operations outward without assuming associativity or commutativity.
set.description: Evaluate a binary operation supplied by a formula, a selection rule or a finite table. Respect the ordered operands and parentheses when nesting operations; do not assume ordinary multiplication or unstated algebraic laws.
set.name: Evaluating defined binary operations
set.nameZh: 自定义二元运算的求值
